name: desk
description: The desk's app (design-015): the REAL desk since D2a-world — React 19 over createCanvasEngine, the mat and its objects drawn FROM THE WORLD through deskLayer(); plus rig.html (the same desk + the rigs' harness: the oracle's scenes behind window.__desk.setScene — D7) and D1's parity page (parity.html). Rigs: rig:parity (Chrome = Node through the oracle's own desk), rig:world (Chrome = Node FROM THE WORLD), rig:interact (the prototype's grammar), rig:idle (0 submits at rest), rig:portal (the mini mats' live insides, the cut and the zoom-through — D2b), rig:nav (the flights, the gesture, the press + double-click cut — D2b), rig:sticky (the note's text: the hand, the editor, typing as a gesture — D2c), rig:two-tab (a typed note crossing a ?room= when its session commits — D2c; M5 two-tab convergence — D5a), rig:collab (M9 live: two tabs through the ws relay the rig starts, each drawing the other's hand — D5a), rig:ruler (the rulers' check rows on a live frame — D5a; the product's own rulers, `u`, the ratio, the selection's extent, the menu, the laser's tick and the print's cost — K1), rig:panel (the dev panel, the backtick — D5a), rig:gpu (the GPU profiler on real frames: unarmed = no wrapper, the dock on ⇧`, one instanced draw per run, the span, the ledger, a trace capture, per-kind cost — design-016 K2; the pegboard drawer's row, armed with it open — K3), rig:tray (the pegboard drawer: its facts, its input, its motion, its pixels, idle — K3); rig:clock (a THIRD-PARTY kind — the desk clock, examples/desk-clock — does what a built-in does: set down by key and taken off the tray, its hands read back from its record and its pixels, a registered wake a second and none between, its menu act, its round pick, its opening, into a mini mat and its chip, two tabs — design-016 K8b); rig:capture (the capture door — `handle.capture` on the parked desk: the still of the view × dpr, the thumbnail, a rect, the ledger's own line and no frame, the oracle still from the world at maxΔ 0, the lost device — petition I23); rig:remount (the kind set — a desk's kinds are the set it was mounted with, so a host remounts to change them: the showcase remounted five times, each mount's device, passes and first presented frame timed, the generation before it at memory-ledger zero, the document untouched; a generation with a refused and a quarantined kind, then one mounted clean — petition I25); units: vitest (M10 exit-imports, M9 collab, the panel's params — D5a).
